 Meet the Milwaukee Brewers’ Wives & Girlfriends: All About Their Relationships
 Morgan Pryor • October 23, 2026, 3:00 pm 
 maileolsenn/Instagram, jakebauers/Instagram 
 The World Series has arrived, and the Milwaukee Brewers are stepping up to the plate. As they face off against the Tampa Bay Rays for the first game on October 23, most of the Brewers will have their loved ones in the stadium. In addition to their family members, most of the players have significant others cheering them on, too.
 First baseman Jake Bauers almost retired from baseball before making it to the World Series. During the 2024 season, his wife, Lauren, was pregnant with their second child, and what brought him back from quitting was the fact that they needed health insurance. Bauers made headlines recently when recalling the story, and he isn’t the only Brewer who’s shared details about his love life. One player is even dating a fellow pro athlete.
 Get all the details on the relationship statuses of the Brewers’ starting lineup, including all the facts about their wives and girlfriends.
 The World Series, FOX 
 Daniel Shirey / MLB Photos via Getty Images 
 William Contreras 
 Status: Engaged 
 William Contreras is engaged to Nixzali Adames, the sister of San Francisco Giants shortstop Willy Adames. In February 2026, they shared photos from the proposal on Instagram . “Let’s be a team all our life. You with me, me with you and God with us,” wrote Nixzali, who has a master’s degree in finance.
 Paige Almendariz / Instagram 
 Christian Yelich
 Status: In a Relationship 
 Captain Christian Yelich is the aforementioned player dating a pro athlete. He’s in a relationship with 29-year-old soccer player Paige Almendariz. She’s a defender for the USL Super League club DC Power. They share their love for each other on social media often, if you want to do your own deep dive into their relationship.
 Haley Cruse Mitchell / Instagram 
 Garrett Mitchell 
 Status: In a Relationship 
 Garrett Mitchell gets game tips from his wife, Haley Cruse Mitchell, a former USSSA Pride professional softball player. She played in college at Oregon. The couple married in 2021, and announced on August 20 that they are expecting a baby daughter.
 Sal Frelick / Instagram 
 Sal Frelick
 Status: In a relationship 
 Right fielder Sal Frelick shows his love for his girlfriend on social media often . He started dating Kendall Hanlon when they both attended Boston College. Kendall played field hockey for the university. She’s often by her boyfriend’s side at events and in the stands during games.
 Lexi Hickman / Instagram 
 Andrew Vaughn 
 Status: Married 
 In 2022, Andrew Vaughn married Lexi Hickman . They were set up in 2018 by mutual friends, but they didn’t pursue a relationship at first. Andrew was attending college at Berkeley, and Lexi was at Ole Miss. Still, they started texting and talking every day. When they both were in Atlanta at the same time a few years later, they went on their first date, per People . Andrew proposed in 2021.
 “Marriage means commitment, trusting, giving and being willing to change. Andrew embodies all of these traits, and I can’t wait to start our forever,” Lexi told People at the time of their wedding.
 Maile Olsen / Instagram 
 Brice Turang 
 Status: In a Relationship 
 Brice Turang is dating Maile Olsen, a California Baptist University and University of Nevada softball alum. Not much is known about their relationship, though she attends games and shares photos of her boyfriend on social media regularly.
 Jansyn Hollis / Instagram 
 Cooper Pratt 
 Status: In a Relationship 
 Jansyn Hollis has been with Cooper Pratt since well before his MLB debut in 2025. She belongs to the The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, like her shortstop boyfriend, and is from Mississippi.
 Joey Ortiz / Instagram 
 Joey Ortiz 
 Status: Married 
 Joey Ortiz tied the knot with Iliana May, who keeps a low profile online, in January 2025. They’re expecting their first child in December.
 David Hamilton / Instagram 
 David Hamilton
 Status: Married 
 David Hamilton’s wife, Mallory, is a Houston Texans cheerleader alumna, per her private Instagram bio . In 2024, he wished her a happy birthday on his Instagram . “You continue to light up my life, there’s never a dull moment with you. I am proud of who you are and all that you do. Grateful to call you mine, and grateful to have a best friend as a partner,” he wrote.
 Jake Bauers / Instagram 
 Jake Bauers
 Status: Married 
 Bauers’ relationship might be the most famous one of the World Series after his retirement comments. He and Lauren tied the knot in 2022. Their daughter, Marlee Jane, was born the following year, and their son was born in 2024.
 “[Lauren] is holding it down at home by herself a lot of the time, which it’s a lot,” Bauers said during an October 12 press conference, per E! News . “Those kids, they’re a blessing and we love them, but man, they’re a handful. So for her to do that and for her to allow me the opportunity to come here and keep going and just support me any way she can, it’s been crazy. It’s been crazy to see her growth as a woman and a mom.”
 Keith Birmingham. /MediaNews Group / Pasadena Star-News via Getty Images 
 Jacob Misiorowski
 Status: Engaged 
 Misiorowski, who has kept most details about his relationship private, got engaged between the 2025 and 2026 baseball seasons. His soon-to-be wife, Elle , played softball in high school.
 Daniel Shirey / MLB Photos via Getty Images 
 Luis Lara
 Status: Single 
 Luis Lara isn’t known to be in a relationship as he embarks on his first World Series. The 21-year-old hasn’t shared any photos of a significant other on his Instagram .
 Harry How / Getty Images 
 Jackson Chourio
 Status: Unclear 
 Jackson Chourio was last known to be in a relationship with Gabriela Alejandra Palmar Finol , a Venezuelan lawyer. Sportskeeda reported on their romance in April 2025. However, there’s no sign of him on her Instagram currently. They also no longer following each other on Instagram, so it’s possible the relationship ended.
